notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight cards in hand.
description:
Move to your cleanup step, discarding down to your maximum hand size.
Bag of Holding triggers for each card discarded this way.
Resolve the first Bag of Holding trigger, exiling the discarded card.
Tormod triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Marneus triggers, causing you to draw a card, or win the game if your library is empty.
Discard down to your maximum hand size.
Repeat from step 2.
